title: Orphan Claim — Convert to Regular (link policy in place, land on Overview)
walkthroughSteps: Apply AC-01 — lands on /fnol/search with a blank form. Type 'Jonas Kaufmann' into Client name and click Search — no state override is needed to find SK-2024-001, since the Claims-tab search already runs against every claim including orphans/skeletons.
On the Claims tab, open SK-2024-001's kebab menu and click 'Convert to claim' — this is the real button, same one available directly on the claim's own Overview page.
A modal opens showing policies matching Jonas Kaufmann, flagged eligible/ineligible (client match + loss date inside coverage). Select the eligible one (POL-2024-021) and click 'Continue conversion'.

Lands directly on /claims/SK-2024-001/overview (2026-09-14 change — no FNOL wizard walk anymore). Same claimId, same history: status is now 'Open', policy number is set, line of business updated from the policy.

A 'This claim needs setup' banner is visible (claimType is still 'skeleton' and it has zero sections) with links to Sections and Financial — this is what tells the handler what's left, since Entities & Damages / Parties / Reserves were never collected through a wizard for this claim.
Add a section from the Sections page — the banner disappears permanently once one exists.
Use 'Update reserves' on the Financial Overview page (Reserves view) to set a reserve — this button had no handler at all before 2026-09-14; it's real now.

Alternate entry point: the same 'Convert to claim' button also lives directly on the claim's Overview page (for a handler who reached it via the Dashboard's Claim Portfolio widget, not Search) — both paths call the same code and end at the same place.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Convert to claim links the policy onto the same claim record and lands on its Overview — no FNOL wizard
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: Clicking **Convert to claim** (from the Claims-tab kebab, or the button on the claim's own Overview page) opens a policy-picker modal. Selecting an eligible policy **updates the same claim record in place** — `policyNumber`, `lineOfBusiness`, and `status` ('Awaiting policy' → 'Open') — and lands on `/claims/:id/overview`. No new claim is created; the claim keeps its original ID. The FNOL wizard is never opened for this flow.

setup.description: SK-2024-001 is static seed data (claims.json) with status 'Awaiting policy' — no state override needed. Search 'Jonas Kaufmann' manually, then use the real kebab action.
